summary: Retest of the 2 fixes from iteration_53. BOTH FIXES VERIFIED. (1) CustomerProposalPage.js — the ACCEPT block now renders for empty-scope portals. Visited /customer-proposal/JXQ8EYEQ/RETESTTOKEN; data-testid='customer-signature-input' and data-testid='customer-accept-btn' both present and visible. Typed 'Final Acceptance Test', clicked ACCEPT, POST /api/customer-proposal/JXQ8EYEQ/RETESTTOKEN/accept returned 200, and data-testid='customer-accepted-banner' rendered with text '✓ PROPOSAL ACCEPTED — Accepted by Final Acceptance Test — Wheeler has been notified.' (2) server.py send_proposal_email — PUBLIC_APP_URL fallback now reads request.headers.get('origin') / 'referer'. Source inspected at lines 20246-20261 (FastAPI Request param + urlsplit on Origin), and live-tested by setting a sentinel customer_accept_token='PRE_CALL_MARKER' then POSTing /api/builder/JXQ8EYEQ/proposal/send-email with Origin='https://design-burst.preview.emergentagent.com' and a Fernet-encrypted fake Resend key. Result: response was 502 with clean detail 'Resend send failed: API key is invalid' (no stack trace leak), and the token in mongo was rotated to a fresh UUID with customer_accept_sent_to/sent_at populated — proving the token persistence + accept_url construction ran BEFORE the email send was attempted. Regression: CompanyProfileForm data-testid='email-setup-section' renders correctly on COMPANY INFO tab; data-testid='send-to-client-btn' renders on Proposal / Quote tab (visible, enabled, text '✉ SEND TO CLIENT'). Backend pytest suite test_proposal_email_white_label.py = 9/9 pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~20,565 lines — STILL vastly over the 700-line guideline. The proposal-email / customer-proposal / company-profile routes (lines 19960-20340) are a self-contained vertical that should move into its own router module (e.g. routers/proposal_email.py). Same recommendation as iteration_53 — not blocking, but technical-debt is compounding.

Good: PUBLIC_APP_URL fallback chain is correct (env → Origin header → Referer header → request.url.netloc). One small nit — `urlsplit` is imported inside the function on line 20254; moving it to the module-level imports avoids the per-request import cost. Not a bug.

Token rotation happens BEFORE the email is dispatched, so a failed Resend/SMTP call still revokes the previous token. This is correct behaviour (the old link goes dead even on failure) but should be documented in the function docstring so future maintainers don't 'fix' it back to post-dispatch.

rca of the issue: Both bugs from iteration_53 are now resolved. RCA refresher: (1) UI gating bug was a stray `grouped.length > 0` guard preventing signature box from rendering when scope was empty — fixed by dropping the length check on line 195 of CustomerProposalPage.js. (2) Hardcoded production domain in the accept-link builder meant preview/staging environments emailed unreachable URLs — fixed by deriving public_base from request.headers.get('origin') / 'referer' / request.url.netloc before falling back to PUBLIC_APP_URL env. No further reproduction available.
